note: A bit-select indexed by a signal rather than a literal - the one index kind no tool can resolve while building the tree, and the only one the rest of the corpus does not have. concat_slice, the assignment-target designs and the reduction fixtures all index with constants. Behavioral because a folded or reversed index is still a one-bit expression that reparses; the stimulus ends with two patterns whose opposite ends disagree, so reading the wrong bit shows.
